final: WITH per_media_type AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track WHERE Bytes >= 10323804 AND Bytes IS NOT NULL AND Milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MediaTypeId) SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS avg_of_media_type_averages, AVG(track_count) AS avg_of_media_type_track_counts FROM per_media_type
